title: 10 DANCE
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shinya Sugiki, Japan's top Standard ballroom dancer, and Shinya Suzuki, its top Latin dancer, agree to teach each other so both can compete in the 10-Dance, which demands mastery of both styles. Rivalry, training and clashing personalities slowly turn into romantic attraction between the two adult men. The series is ongoing.
life_message: Excellence comes from pushing yourself and learning from a rival, and that rival may become the person you love.
